g.text: kb from the anchor's centre along its strand (upstream left); // = end of a linear contig

path.style: fill: none; stroke: #000000; stroke-width: 0.8; stroke-linejoin: miter; stroke-linecap: square

g.text: other families (each in < 10% of the group's loci, weighted)
nbr flanks: group all, 157 loci in 116 leaves (116 in the tree, 18 context types)
release rN.3, level nr50, window 6g, distance j, cut 0.9986 (at most 10 types, --auto-cut 10); a family's colour is the same in every group of the run; % = share of the group's loci holding it

--colour-weight anchor-nr90: a locus weighs 1/(loci of its anchor-nr90) in the %, so near-identical loci count once; --colour-fallback pfam: a grey cluster takes its Pfam architecture's colour if that is in >= 10%
rows: 60 of 116 leaves (--figure-rows 60): the leaf with the most loci of each context type, then the leaves with the most loci; the tree is restricted to them
